packageRules.description: Composer constraint strings mirror the fresh Laravel reference and are changed only by the update-laravel-packages skill; Renovate updates lockfile resolutions within the existing ranges. Close any Renovate PR that edits composer.json and route it through the skill instead.
Composer major updates go through the update-laravel-packages skill, which classifies provenance against a fresh Laravel reference before changing constraints.
Group Composer minor and patch updates.
Group pnpm minor and patch updates through Renovate's npm manager.
